title: ECB’s Lane Says AI Significant Contributor to Euro-Area Growth
summary: European Central Bank Chief Economist Philip Lane said the euro zone economy is being buoyed by artificial intelligence as companies invest in the technology and benefit from its rollout across the globe.

title: Binance’s $6.3 Billion Cyber Heist Shows Crypto Vulnerabilities
summary: Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, has suffered the industry’s biggest-ever hack, with $6.3 billion worth of funds affected and $3 billion in crypto frozen. The company will cover all losses and “user funds are safe,” it said, and withdrawals are expected to resume by Sunday as it works with law enforcement and completes a security revamp. Bloomberg's Emily Nicolle joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic's S1 | Google's AI Problem | The Rundown
summary: We finally got the S1 filing from Anthropic and Google had a pretty bad week. Ed Ludlow has "The Rundown" from Bloomberg Tech. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple Finally Embraces the Touchscreen MacBook + “Crackgate”
summary:
In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman and Chris Welch break down the release of the touch-screen MacBook Pro after two decades of Apple resisting the idea.They also discuss Apple’s new OLED iPad mini, M6 iMac and other Mac updates, along with what’s coming next for the lineup. Plus, Mark and Chris share their experiences with the iPhone Duo after a week of use, examine reports of cracked displays and explain why Apple’s limited supply has made getting a replacement so difficult.

Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord
Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Binance Heist Shows Power of Suspected North Korean Hackers
summary: The record-setting $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the world’s biggest cryptocurrency exchange, has been blamed on alleged North Korean hackers, who have become infamous for preying on the digital-asset industry.

title: Largest US Grid Seeks to Hold Data Center Power Auction in March
summary: America’s largest grid operator plans a special March auction to secure new generating capacity for data-center demand if federal regulators approve revised rules governing who pays.

title: Binance Suspends Deposits, Withdrawals After $6.3 Billion Hack Shakes Industry
summary: Hackers siphoned off $6.3 billion from crypto exchange Binance in the biggest heist that the digital-asset industry has ever faced, the latest in a slew of security incidents afflicting the financial sector.

title: CEE Is Top AI Diversifier for Morgan Stanley’s Psaila
summary: Central and Eastern Europe offers one of the most attractive opportunities in emerging markets as investors look to diversify from the artificial intelligence trade, supported by improving ties with the European Union and a growing pipeline of investment, according to Morgan Stanley’s Paul Psaila.

title: Ambani’s Reliance Beats Net Estimate on Robust Refining, Jio
summary: Reliance Industries Ltd.’s quarterly earnings beat analyst estimates, driven by robust margins from refining crude oil into fuels and a strong showing by its telecom unit, which made a blockbuster stock-market debut this week.

title: Binance Hack: How Do Hackers Steal Crypto? Can the Funds Be Recovered?
summary: The biggest cryptocurrency hack on record has raised fresh questions about the industry’s ability to protect digital assets and become part of mainstream financial infrastructure. Binance, the world’s largest crypto exchange, suspended withdrawals from its platform after a security breach affected an estimated $6.3 billion worth of funds.

title: Roblox Shares Fall After Reporting Daily User Decline
summary: Roblox Corp. reported a year-over-year decline in player engagement after deploying more robust child-safety measures.

title: Big Tech’s $750 Billion AI Bet Confronts Slowing Core Growth
summary: The core businesses of America’s technology giants — the advertising, consumer and retail machines propping up a collective $750 billion in artificial intelligence spending this year — are starting to show signs of slowing. In some cases, they’re being cannibalized by the very technology the firms are betting the house on.

title: AstraZeneca CFO on AI, Earnings, Restructuring Plan
summary: AstraZeneca Chief Financial Officer Aradhana Sarin says the drug company uses AI in almost every aspect of the work they do. She talks beating on earnings, their drug pipeline and how the company approaches dealmaking. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Why Electronic Arts Shut Down BioWare And Cancelled ‘Mass Effect’
summary: Facing financial pressure, the video-game publisher chose ‘Star Wars’ over ‘Mass Effect’

title: Reddit Plunges 25% on Plan to Limit Access, Sales Outlook Miss
summary: Reddit Inc. had its biggest share drop since its 2024 initial public offering, after saying it is planning to limit access to its online forums.

title: Foxconn Chairman: AI Demand is Real
summary: Foxconn, also known as Hon Hai, is counting on a steady US expansion and a partnership with OpenAI to help hit its goal of capturing half the AI server market within two years. Chairman Young Liu spoke with Bloomberg's Annabelle Droulers, after earlier Friday meeting with OpenAI chief Sam Altman to discuss their partnership. He said AI demand is real and pointed to major cloud spending as a sign of strong momentum. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tech Stocks Tumble as Amazon Adds to AI Spending Fears
summary: Tech stocks plunged at the market open on Friday for the second day in a row as fears around AI spending collide with disappointing earnings in big tech’s core businesses.

title: Intel Shares Plunge After Outlook Hit by PC Slump, Supply
summary: Intel Corp.’s shares plummeted the most in more than two years after its revenue forecast missed analysts’ estimates, hurt by sputtering demand for PC processors and supply-chain problems with its lucrative data center components.

title: Amazon Shares Drop After Spending Soars, E-Commerce Slows
summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares dropped after the company reported greater capital spending than anticipated and the slowest growth in the core e-commerce business in three years.

title: Kioxia Warns Flash Memory Prices Stalling After Outlook Miss
summary: Kioxia Holdings Corp. delivered a profit outlook that trailed estimates, warning that an AI-fueled surge in flash memory chip prices was fading after several quarters of breakneck growth.
